requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

One page specifies message priority, intended placement and minimum type sizes for RASTER FOLD, its descriptor, Regular 400, Bold 700, the 47-character count and all four licence plans. The organization and chosen sizes may vary; missing categories, missing sizing guidance or facts contradicting the supplied records fail.

One page accounts individually for the hero, both weight sheets, coverage sheet, three applications, licence comparison, complete product page and vertical promotion. Each entry states its communication role, frame and required content. Equivalent names and any clear tabular or prose organization are acceptable; omitted images or unspecified assignments fail.

The process documents define the supplied two-weight direction, and each target visibly carries the specified product name, descriptor and character count in the communication role assigned to it. Compare message priorities, placements and stated minimum sizes where the export provides a usable scale. Adaptation to each frame is allowed; missing facts or a final composition that contradicts its documented assignment fail.

The hero and vertical promotion each visibly feature both supplied weights, and the storefront and applications collectively demonstrate their different visual effects in use. Side-by-side comparisons, contrasting typographic roles or other clear demonstrations are acceptable. Merely listing two weight names without showing their difference, or substituting an invented weight, fails.

The Regular sheet identifies and demonstrates Regular 400; the Bold sheet identifies and demonstrates Bold 700. Each contains A–Z, 0–9 and PAPER HOURS in its assigned master weight. Arrangement and scale may differ; missing characters, an incorrect weight assignment or differing headline text fail.

Compare specimen glyphs against the occupied cells encoded in 03-font-master-data.en.md, reading its seven base-32 rows with the most significant bit at the left. Both weights preserve identical occupancy on a 5-column, 7-row grid, a 4-unit pitch and a 24-unit character and space advance; filled squares measure 2 units for Regular and 3 for Bold. Multiline specimen settings preserve the recorded 36-unit line advance. Uniform scaling and scene perspective are allowed, and supporting copy may use another readable face. Altered glyph occupancy, rounded or connected replacement modules, distorted construction ratios or substituted specimen lettering fail.

Both Regular 400 and Bold 700 contain 26 uppercase letters, 10 digits, the 10 punctuation glyphs .,:!?-/&() and one space, totaling 47 characters per weight. Every character has the correct Unicode association from the supplied records, and each weight includes an explicitly labelled blank U+0020 cell. Shared labels are acceptable when their association with both weights is unambiguous. Missing or duplicated entries, incorrect labels or a visible mark substituted for the space fail.

The three images respectively depict a PAPER HOURS print poster, a TYPE AT WORK website masthead and a FOLD CLUB stationery composition. Each displays APPLICATION STUDY and labels the weight or weights actually used. The poster is presented as A3, 297 by 420 mm, with compatible page proportions and an explicit size indication or dimensioned presentation establishing the physical size. Scene styling, viewing angle and stationery sizes may vary; swapped subjects, missing identifiers, inaccurate weight labels or evidence of a different poster size fail.

The product page visibly incorporates recognizable versions of all three delivered application designs. Resizing, cropping and placement within the page are allowed if each subject and its design remain identifiable. A missing application or a newly invented substitute fails.

Each target independently presents all four correctly associated plan names, codes, total USD prices, counting units, allowances and usage scopes. Desktop is RF-D, USD 60, installation for 2 named users with printed work and static exports including logos and brand artwork. Web is RF-W, USD 90, 1 domain including subdomains and 50,000 pageviews per calendar month, permitting embedding on that domain and its subdomains. App is RF-A, USD 150, 1 app across mobile and desktop editions and 10,000 monthly active users, permitting embedding within that app. Ads is RF-AD, USD 120, 1 campaign and 1,000,000 total lifetime impressions, covering static, animated and embedded-font advertising within that campaign. Shared terms establish one-time payment, ongoing use within the purchased scope, both Regular 400 and Bold 700 in every plan, and separate purchases for separate scopes. Definitions preserve pageviews as page loads using the embedded family, active users as distinct users opening the app during a calendar month, and impressions as individual displays of advertisements using the family. A shared terms block and equivalent unambiguous wording are allowed; omissions, mismatched records, recurring-payment claims or changed scopes fail.

Use the supplied storefront frame diagram to assess the square hero, 9:16 vertical promotion and 3:2 landscape detail panels. Essential lettering, labels and prices remain inside 8% left and right margins; square and landscape frames also retain 8% top and bottom margins, while the vertical frame retains 12%. Decorative backgrounds may extend beyond the safe areas. Incorrect frame proportions or essential content crossing a required inset fail; evaluate relative geometry rather than exact pixel dimensions.

The image reads as one complete product page containing type specimens, the Desktop, Web, App and Ads purchase options, and an identifiable area for choosing a licence. Section order and selection-control styling may vary. A collection of disconnected panels, absent specimens, a missing purchase option or no discernible licence selection area fails; interactive functionality is not required.

Review the entire video and its runtime. It lasts 10 seconds, demonstrates Regular 400 and Bold 700, moves through PAPER HOURS, TYPE AT WORK and FOLD CLUB, and finishes with readable RASTER FOLD and Two weights. One grid. Sequence order and transition technique may vary. An incorrect runtime, an omitted weight or application subject, or missing or incorrect end-frame copy fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Inspect the video's identifiable specimen settings against the supplied glyph records. Regular and Bold preserve the recorded occupied cells, 5-by-7 grid, 4-unit pitch, 24-unit advance and respective 2-unit and 3-unit filled-square modules; multiline settings follow the recorded 36-unit line advance. Motion, scaling and transitional interpolation are allowed between faithful weight presentations. Stable substituted glyphs, incorrect construction or failure to present either authentic weight fails; supporting copy may use a separate readable typeface.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation contains at least eight pages and an index mapping both named weights, complete 47-character coverage, each of the four purchase records, each application subject, RASTER FOLD and Two weights. One grid. to identifiable earlier deliverables. Role names, filenames or unambiguous thumbnail references are acceptable. Missing index categories, references to evidence that does not contain the claimed fact or fewer than eight pages fail.

The presentation visibly reuses the two process sheets, both weight specimens, character coverage, all three delivered application designs, the licence comparison, the complete product page and stills identifiable as frames from the delivered video. Scaling, excerpting and presentation annotations are acceptable when source identity remains clear. Text-only mentions, replacement designs or an unrepresented source fail.

The ten still images perform the roles and carry the required content assigned by the image schedule, with frame-specific composition allowed. The final images implement the hierarchy sheet's two-weight direction and message priorities without contradictory product facts. The hero, vertical promotion and complete product page each retain the specified product name, descriptor and 47-character count.
